decisions.reason: After several years on the market, bleaching tray blanks still fit the firm's dental materials and thermoforming knowledge very closely, so accumulated learning and established channels favour continued refinement rather than withdrawal.

The PETG thermoforming blank remains highly aligned with the firm's core dental laboratory materials capabilities, certified production routines, and customer base, making it a strong candidate to retain.

UV-curing lacquer is related enough to the firm's materials and R&D base to be improvable, but its weaker strategic visibility than the core device and blank lines keeps withdrawal risk meaningfully higher.
The custom earmold line builds directly on long-established hearing-care custom manufacturing know-how, so the firm is well placed to interpret market feedback and keep developing the range.

Custom hearing protection earmolds are an adjacent extension of the firm's earmold expertise and specialist channels, so they are likely to stay, though their broader application leaves somewhat more uncertainty than the core earmold range.
